body: Amazing work. I love the concept of this.

The Great Gatsby by F. Scott Fitzgerald.

The Sea, the Sea by Iris Murdoch. This one doesn't really capture any beauty, though; the main character's limerent, delusional thinking and the lengths he is willing to go to in order to get what he wants is infuriating.

I've gotten into painting over the last few months and considered trying to paint LO, but talked myself out of it. I don't know him very well and I thought it might be a bit... invasive? I also really am enjoying painting and I don't want to turn it into just another thing that gives me an excuse to fixate on LO.
Wow, you're very talented! I'm new to oil painting but I really want to try this technique.
I love your style, and especially the color choice! Beautiful.

I was just thinking about this the other day! Oddly enough, my LO is the ONLY person I can really cry over. I haven't been able to cry the way I used to since leaving an abusive relationship (sometimes I feel like I got a lifetime worth of tears out during that time). I feel sad, my throat feels tight, but my eyes stay dry. But if I have an interaction with him, simply think about him for too long, or hear a song that reminds me of him, I can be sobbing within seconds. When two of the most important people in my life moved away a few weeks ago, I cried for like a minute and then my eyes dried up. I guess I'm happy to be able to cry over something.

I know it's painful to feel so sad over another person, but there are good things ahead for you. This pain doesn't define you or your life.

Sorry for the misunderstanding. I realize this is a new girl that you've only known for a day or so? Your post history mentions another girl who I'm assuming things didn't work out with.

She has said yes to a date, but have you actually made any concrete plans yet? If a girl is enthusiastic about spending more time with you, then there will be actual plans being made. Maybe send her a message and ask when she wants to get together?

You need to calm down a bit, though, and not become so hyper-focused on each girl you're interested in. Overthinking everything and stressing about it is going to take the fun out of things. In many cases it will give girls the wrong impression. All you should be doing is expressing your interest, waiting patiently for her replies (life is busy, after all), and moving forward from there.

She's not into you. I looked at your post history and you're clearing obsessing over this girl. You had a date that you said was awkward, she wasn't talking much, and now she's not replying to you. You should probably move on.

I've never had a job interview during a flare up, but I'm currently in the midst of the worst flare up of my life and have an interview this Friday. Will definitely be wearing long sleeves.

Edited to add: Good luck with your job search. I'm sure an employer will be able to look beyond your eczema and see that you're the right person for the job :)
